kind: Edit Form Fields, Edit Post-Submit, Lightbox and the panel's tabs on a form block
how: A new Form through the Add Block menu on Blocks Probe, unsaved, each session left with Exit Without Saving and ending with 0 blocks and Save off. Presses went through a helper that checks the element is on top, except where presses lists one. Additional Storage, reCAPTCHA, Email Notification and Form Style were not pressed.
whyTheRowsDidNotOpen: The earlier probe's press went to the wrong element and never opened the row. A press on the 16 by 16 arrow, named Navigate to Edit Form Fields, opens it, and so does a press on the row's label.

panelTabs.note: The tabs stay. Only what is under them scrolls: the panel is 500 high, the tab row 55, the scroller starts at 55, 447 high, 640 of content on Content. A Back row stays the same way.

c: DIV||Click and drag to reposition block editor form|||||BackEdit Form Fields|0,0,320,55

fieldList.note: Back and Edit Form Fields on top, a row per field with a drag handle, icon, label, red Delete and arrow, then Add Field. Delete on a row removes it at once, with no dialog. A press on a row opens its editor. Dragging a row moves the field in the form.

addField.note: A tile adds the field at the end of the form and goes back to the list. It does not open the new field.
addField.xPrefix: The X field has a prefix box with the x.com address in it, which is left out here.

blockFits.note: The block's rows follow the form: rows grow and shrink so the form fits, and the section grows with them. The block can read tall for a moment before it settles.

postSubmit.note: Message and Redirect; Message has a text box with Thank you!, Alignment and Position with three each, and an HTML code box. Redirect has Attach link. What these draw after a submit is not read: a submit writes to form storage.

canvas.note: While the view is open the block shows what comes after a submit. The form stays in the same grid cell, hidden, and sets the height, block and rows unchanged. The Submit word stays showing, white, with no button behind it. The text box is rich text, HTML a code editor. Both views show the message. On Back the form returns.

html.note: Drawn as HTML under the message, not aligned with it.

attachLink.note: The link menu with URL and the site list. What the row shows after a link is set: not read.

text: Form style affects all forms on your site. @22,-55,222,26

lightbox.note: On: the form leaves and a button named Open Form takes its place, 204 by 67, left aligned; the rows Button Text and Background Color appear and the Background, Stroke, Blend Mode and Blur rows go. Button Text is empty with Open Form as its placeholder. Off: the form comes back. A press on the button in the preview of an unsaved form opened nothing, twice, so what the open lightbox draws is not read.

submissions.manage: A link to the Contacts page's form submitters, in a new tab. Read by going there: an empty list with Email, First Name, Last Name, Total Submissions, Last Submission and Email Subscribed.
submissions.export: A press fades the row for a moment. No dialog, nothing else on screen. No submissions are stored on the trial site.

followUp.menu: An option's ... menu has one row, Add Follow-Up Question. It opens Add Follow-Up with the same 19 tiles.

undo: Undo did not step back a field's change. After adding a Dropdown one Undo left it there; after typing a label and a description one Undo left both, and the next removed the whole Form block. Ours takes one step per change.
presses: The press on the lightbox button in the preview checked the element on top inside the frame.
The row drag in the list checked the row was on top at its start.
notRead: What a form's open lightbox draws: the preview opens nothing on an unsaved form.
What the Message, Alignment, Position, HTML and Redirect do after a submit: a submit writes to form storage.
Follow-up questions past Add Follow-Up: no tile pressed.
Send confirmation email and SMS Marketing Opt-in: not pressed. View plans: not pressed.
Email Notification, Additional Storage, reCAPTCHA: not pressed.
How an option is removed: its menu has one row, and an emptied option stays as an empty row.

drawn.note: Item height and control boxes (x, y from the item top, width, height) at 1600 wide, a form 518 wide. plain: Subject has a description and placeholder, every other field as added. withDescription: every added field has a description, Required on where it has one, Phone shows its country code, a Dropdown has its own placeholder and a third option left empty.

oursDiffers: The block's rows fit in the same step as a change. The oracle settles a step late on add, duplicate, delete and toggles: reads in blockFits.
A typed value fits when the field is left. The oracle did not change rows for typing while the panel stayed in the field.
One undo step per change. The oracle's Undo did not step field changes back: reads in undo.
The Country list is the browser's region names, 251 of them, with Norway chosen. The oracle has 245. The Phone prefix stays +47.
The field and tile icons are our own drawings.
Ours' Message box is plain text: a new line is a new paragraph. The oracle's is rich text, whose formatting is not read.
Ours' HTML box has no colours or code editor. It takes the same text.
In ours' Preview frame a redirect shows the message, so the editor stays open. On the page itself it follows the link.
inferred: Hidden's Variable follows the Label: only SQF_HIDDEN for the label Hidden was read.
A grip on an option moves the option: only the field list's drag was read.
The Name part hidden by Show keeps its Require value for when it comes back.
A real submit draws the message as the view does, and the Submit word goes.
A message taller than the form: not read.

checkboxGap.note: Read on the Contact page and on a form added to a probe page. Ours: imported fields keep 14, tile-made Checkbox and Radio use 18. Why they differ, and which a Checkbox added to the Contact form takes, is not read.
